title: Jobat.be Jobs Scraper
description: Collect job listings from Jobat.be search pages with enriched job details and clean output.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Jobat search URL to start from.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword to search for (e.g., software developer).

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to visit per start URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used when Jobat.be blocks the connection (HTTP 403). Enable Apify Proxy or set custom proxy URLs; the scraper falls back to a direct connection when the proxy is unavailable.
